content.title: Where to watch Tennessee-Virginia basketball: TV, channel, streaming
content.text: No. 6 seed Tennessee (23-11) basketball advanced to the NCAA Tournament second round. The Vols will face No. 3 seed Virginia (30-5) on Sunday at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Tipoff between the Vols and Cavaliers is scheduled for 6:10 p.m. EDT. Virginia defeated No. 14 seed Wright State (23-12), 82-73, in the first round. Tennessee advanced to the second round after a, 78-56, victory against No. 11 Miami University (32-2). Virginia leads the all-time basketball series, 8-6, dating to Feb. 22, 1917. Below is how to watch information for the Tennessee-Virginia basketball game on Sunday.
